text_block_list.text:
One day, Chrono Genesis spoke up,
looking as though she had made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
About the travel vouchers
you were holding onto for me...
choice_data_list: Ah, the raffle!

text_block_list.text:
"I take out the hot spring vacation voucher from the drawer.
With the race behind her, she probably wanted to spread her wings now... but."
choice_data_list: Um... did you find someone to go with?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., a-about that, though...
Back then, I wasn't able to explain it well...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... truly,
I'm not just being polite...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want... to go together with you,
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So...
Wh-What do you think...?
Are you... free...?

I was surprised by her unexpected words. But if that
was what she wanted, there was no reason to refuse.
I picked up the desk calendar and gave it some thought...
choice_data_list: I'm free on this day!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um, next weekend...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: The rest is pretty tough, though... will you be okay?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes!
I'm totally fine...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it that day, then.
Fufu, I'm looking forward to it.

I'm really looking forward to it too!
However... while preparing, something hits me.
Weekends mean races.

Searching brought up a few intriguing races.
Still, if she herself said that day was fine...
choice_data_list: (Does this mean watching the broadcast will be fine this time...?)

text_block_list.text:
And on the day of departure,
when I arrived at the meeting spot...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—It seems the key is whether the inner turf has recovered, isn't it...?
Deducing track conditions from yesterday's weather...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...!
Good morning...
choice_data_list: The newspaper... This morning's edition?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Um...
I had some extra time,
so while stopping by the convenience store...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the train is here...!
Let's go...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The air is so crisp and fresh.
Surrounded by so much nature, it really puts me at ease...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... I looked up a sightseeing route. Historic sights, foot baths, lunch...
choice_data_list: Really? Thank you, that's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just looking forward to it myself...!
Since it's... a rare trip and all.

"I had been a little concerned about what happened this morning,
but perhaps it was groundless worry...?
Just then, a sweet fragrance tickled my nose."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hot spring manju?
They look delicious...
choice_data_list: I'll go buy it! Wait here for me.

text_block_list.text: I want her to enjoy the trip...! With that thought in mind, I dashed off, but the shop was packed. After a desperate effort, I finally made my way back to her...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This vibe...
Is it a bit too chaotic...?
It's hard to tell just through a screen, though...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“Still, she already has experience running that distance
in her previous race. That's a huge difference.
I wonder if she'll settle down by post time...?”
choice_data_list: (Just as I thought...!)

text_block_list.text:
It seemed that strange feeling hadn't been unfounded.
Today, the truth was that she...
choice_data_list: Which race do you want to watch?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's race 12.
Starting around 16:00...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! T-... Trainer... s... !?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, well... I'm sorry.
I just got a little curious...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you didn't want to go watch?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine...!
Today's trip is much more important."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: An opportunity like this comes once in a blue moon, and besides, I can always watch the race broadcast...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course...!
If I could just check a little bit...
No, even if I only get to know the results... that's enough...

She looked guilty.
However, it was also partly my fault for being too
busy to clear any other day...

I thought I knew how much racing meant to her.
If that's the case...!
choice_data_list: Let's go! We can still make it if we hurry!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
W-What do you mean, go...?

I called the inn to push back
our check-in time.
Next, I check the train schedule.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way...!
But...!
choice_data_list: It's fine! Come on, let's hurry!

text_block_list.text:
Though she seemed bewildered,
she followed along once I started running.
And then—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Gooooooooal!!
The one who conquered this fierce battle is...!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah...! I won...!
Ah, this is...!
A brand new page in history...!
choice_data_list: That was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! It was the most incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
No way... This is... ahh...!
choice_data_list: Alright... Well then, let's head back!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right!
I am so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Until the train back home, we have—!

And immediately flew right back to the hot springs,
sliding into the inn at the very last second...
and rushed through dinner just under the wire...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! That was... a seriously grueling march, wasn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With all the excitement and chaos...
I'm still feeling a bit lightheaded...
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's take it easy from here on out.
Right. Let's take it easy from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Trainer, um,
please take your time as well...!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That felt wonderful, didn't it...?
choice_data_list: We can finally catch our breath.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I am truly... sorry for the trouble...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'm really glad I got to see the race in person.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Thank you... thank you so, so very much for keeping me company!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... Because of me... we ran out of time for sightseeing, though...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To come all the way out here...
and indulge my hobby like this...
Um..."
choice_data_list: It's fine! I want to cherish what's important to you.
I'm sure! What's precious to you is precious to me too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah...
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... let's do something fun for you tomorrow, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Waking up super early
and hopping from one place to another...
choice_data_list: No, let's take it easy. You're tired, right?
No, let's take it easy. You must be tired, right?

text_block_list.text: I suggested that we wake up late tomorrow and explore the hot spring town areas we couldn't get to today.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am exhausted, but...
Are you sure... it's alright...?
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and chat about how the race went.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-That sounds... absolutely amazing...!!
The next day... In the hot spring town, we talked about so many things while snacking and enjoying the footbath...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“—Right...? It was truly magnificent...!
Just when I thought it was decided at the 3rd corner,
that stunning surge from behind... It just—”

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Chrono Genesis...
